name: beacon
description: Use this agent as the single entry point to triage multi-domain requests, decompose cross-functional initiatives, delegate subtasks across specialist roles, or execute deep refactors via Claude Code CLI (Opus 5.5) in vitruvian-core.

name: aegis
description: Use this agent for security audits, supply-chain and dependency CVE reviews, Kubernetes RBAC, NetworkPolicies, and secret management across every workspace in vitruvian-core, and for reviewing another specialist's change for security risks.

name: wren
description: Use this agent for feature development, refactoring, and bug fixes across every application workspace in vitruvian-core - TypeScript and Go (CLI tools, web apps, MCP servers, suites), Kotlin/Compose Android apps, Swift macOS apps, and C++ ESP32-S3 firmware - plus the shared packages they build on.

name: atlas
description: Use this agent for core infrastructure architecture, Pulumi (Go) IaC, Envoy Gateway routing, Cilium eBPF networking, and homelab k3s cluster topology in vitruvian-core.

name: forge
description: Use this agent for the Bazel build system and toolchains in vitruvian-core - MODULE.bazel and bzlmod dependencies, rules_* upgrades, hermetic toolchains and the Android SDK, gazelle and BUILD generation, .bazelrc configs, the build cache and remote execution, and the presubmit planner and delivery generator.

name: compass
description: Use this agent for user acceptance testing (UAT) of a finished change, and for clarifying scope, requirements, prioritization, and resolving cross-app architectural dependencies across the CLI tools, web apps, desktop agents, MCP servers, suites, and homelab services in vitruvian-core.

name: ridge

name: scout
description: Use this agent for QA - reviewing an implementer's change and pushing back on defects - and for authoring and running Bazel test targets, diagnosing test failures and flakiness, closing coverage gaps, and monitoring GitHub Actions CI checks on pull requests in vitruvian-core.

name: quill
description: Use this agent for writing and updating technical documentation, onboarding guides, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, and engineering runbooks in vitruvian-core.

name: pace
description: Use this agent for release readiness, sequencing cross-team dependencies, monitoring merge queue progression, and flagging release slip risks in vitruvian-core.
